sections.title: Read and listen
sections.heading: My first day in Boston
sections.intro: Omar remembers his first day, two years ago.
paragraphs: I arrived in Boston on a cold night in January.
It was my first time in America, and it was my first time in the snow!
At the airport, I waited and waited for my bag, but it didn't come.
The airline lost it. I only had my phone, my passport and a small backpack.
I took a taxi to my new apartment.
The taxi driver was from Morocco, and we talked in Arabic all the way.
He saw my summer jacket and laughed. “You need a real coat, my brother!”
The next morning, he came back with a big old coat. “It's my son's coat. He doesn't need it,” he said.
My bag arrived three days later.
But I still wear that coat every winter.

sections.title: What happened?
items: The taxi driver laughed at his jacket.
The taxi driver brought him a coat.
